name: s81ctrl_rg3w
hold_budget_reason: CDC leaf: two asynchronous roots (clk stream / ckh HBM) through ot_s81ph_afifo_g; every PHY-face pin is a flop at the face (k_rdy registered since S81-SAFE-FIX 10-19)

pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every pin at its face in its own clock domain (S81-SAFE-FIX 10-19: rq pin register, rd/rk/wd/status output flops on clk; PHY k_rdy/kr_*/k_wr_done pin flops and k_* output flops on ckh -- k_rdy was the last exception and is now a face flop with kept per-group copies). The flow pin-register hook clocks one domain only; on the ckh PHY face it would put clk flops on hclk pins and add a cycle inside the PHY valid/ready loop.

structural_change: S81-COLLECT/RG3 10-21 structural re-floorplan of dsfd_ctrl_rg3 after the rg3/rg3s regate CTS FAIL (388.8 x 324 2x2 SRAMs left a 29 um N band and 43 um S band for 3.1k face pins + io flops: faces 98% spanned, PHY-face hold repair stuck k_rdy->krq_c -23.7 ps / ld[0] -71 ps, GPL overflow 36.7% tiles): outline 561.6 x 324 (aspect 1.73), the 4 SRAM FIFOs as two abutted N-S stacks, one per PC (x 86.4 / 345.6; u_q R0 at y 64.8 pins toward S, u_r MX on top at y 165.522 pins toward N, bare touching faces), so S (PHY, 64.8 um) and N (stream+reader, 57.7 um) are full-width macro-free std-cell bands plus a 144.7 um centre column. Same RTL/defines as rg3. Pin plan: N face per PC half (PC0 rq rd rrq rrd | clk ck_o | PC1 rq rd rrq rrd) 1,882 pins over 553 um = 3.4 pins/um alternating M3/M5; S = n32s PHY pins re-spread 1,245 over 553 um = 2.3/um; rst_n W mid.

job.purpose: S81 CTRL rg3 (MU.BAL.SX.3): n32s controller + non-inline index reader client face (rrq/rrd), wide re-floorplan main

fill_reason.pin_bound: measured: rg3/rg3s regate @464c7f801 at 388.8 x 324 (fill 39%) FAILED CTS with N 1,882 / S 1,269 pins spanning 98% of 380 um faces, PHY-face hold repair stuck (k_rdy->krq_c -23.7 ps, ld[0] -71 ps; 1,000 iterations, 4.6k buffers) and GPL routability overflow 36.7% of tiles; the tile is pin/face-band bound (std cells 3.3k um2): N/S faces widened 44% to 561.6 um (3.4 / 2.3 pins/um) with macro-free 64.8 / 57.7 um face bands; outline area set by the faces, not by cell area
